recipes.notes: stargazer-a is the Stargazer of the direction (a brass telescope on a tripod, a starry nightcap with a pompom, a star chart; 68 x 54 px), but its astronomer has a pink face, white hair and a beard: the direction allows no face, no skin and no beard.

recipes.editInstruction: Erase the small round creature with the face at the bottom, the small curled tentacle on the left and the loose drop on the right, so only the one tall thick teal tentacle remains: it rises straight up from a flat cut base at the bottom and curls over at the top, with its row of suckers and the one eye at its tip. The suckers become pale cream, colour #f3e7c4, with no pink. Keep the tall tentacle, the thick black outline and the art style the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: tentacle-a drew the tall tentacle with its suckers and an eye at the tip, but growing out of a small round creature with a face, a second tentacle and a loose drop; the direction asks for one limb with nothing else.

recipes.promptAddendum: There is no animal in the image: only one single limb, like an elephant trunk standing upright on its flat cut end, with no body, no head and no face at its foot; its only eye is at the curled tip. The tentacle is drawn large: about 34 pixels wide and 72 pixels tall. It is deep-sea teal, colour #1f8f95 with shade #145f6b, its suckers pale cream, colour #f3e7c4, and its eye pale yellow, colour #ffe27a. Nothing on it glows green.
recipes.negativeAddendum: octopus, squid, animal, creature body, head, face, mouth, teeth, two eyes, second tentacle, several tentacles, drops, hole, water, splash, puddle, green slime, purple, violet, pink, red
recipes.notes: A second creation that names the piece as one limb with no animal.

recipes.editInstruction: Change only the small creature at the bottom right of the heap: its head with the two big white eyes and its mouth become one more fat teal tentacle coil with one small round pale yellow eye, colour #ffe27a, like the other tentacles of the heap, so the heap has no face. Keep the pile of teal tentacles, every yellow eye, the broken round wooden trapdoor in the middle, the striped party hat, the shape, the thick black outline and the art style the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: thing-c is the mound of the direction (a heap of teal tentacles with yellow eyes all over, a broken wooden trapdoor in its middle, a party hat; 80 x 84 px), but a small creature with a face and two white eyes sits at its bottom right.
